jobs.title: Mid-Level GEOINT Geospatial Analyst
jobs.description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

Nightwing is seeking a Mid-Level GEOINT Geospatial Analyst to support a federal government customer and critical national security missions.

The selected candidate will apply geospatial intelligence (GEOINT), tactical intelligence analysis, and full-motion video (FMV) exploitation expertise to support operational requirements. The analyst will leverage A-ISR systems, motion imagery, geospatial tools, and intelligence platforms to analyze information and produce accurate, timely, and actionable intelligence.

This position requires an active DoD TS/SCI security clearance.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct tactical intelligence and GEOINT analysis in support of federal government missions.
Perform operational Full-Motion Video (FMV) analysis and exploitation.
Analyze motion imagery and geospatial information to identify, track, and characterize relevant activities and targets.
Utilize geospatial and imagery-analysis tools to support intelligence production.
Apply knowledge of A-ISR systems and programs to support mission requirements.
Utilize Google Earth, Motion Imagery PED software, and Microsoft Office applications in daily analytical activities.
Operate applicable intelligence systems and software to support collection, exploitation, analysis, and dissemination.
Produce accurate, timely, and actionable intelligence products for government customers and mission partners.
Support intelligence operations involving U.S. Army and U.S. Air Force manned and unmanned A-ISR systems.
Collaborate with other intelligence analysts and operational personnel in a mission-focused environment.
Brief and communicate analytical findings clearly to government and mission stakeholders.
Maintain awareness of intelligence priorities, operational requirements, and applicable analytic standards.

Basic Qualifications

Current DoD TS/SCI security clearance.
Minimum 1 year of tactical intelligence analysis experience.
Minimum 1 year of A-ISR FMV systems and programs experience.
Minimum 1 year of operational experience as an FMV analyst.
Proficiency with:
Microsoft Office
Google Earth
Motion Imagery PED software

Experience with at least two of the following systems or software:
AIDE
DCGS-A
MIRC
PIDGIN
GETS
AIMES
NGDS
GSR
CEDALION
UVDS
OMAR
TLV
UNICORN
PRISM

Familiarity with U.S. Army and U.S. Air Force manned and unmanned A-ISR systems.

Education & Experience Requirements

Candidates must meet one of the following combinations:

Option 1

Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of current A-ISR FMV experience within the past 3 years.

Option 2

Associate’s degree and 4 years of current A-ISR FMV experience within the past 3 years.

Option 3

High school diploma and 6 years of current A-ISR FMV experience within the past 3 years.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience supporting DoD or federal intelligence missions.
Experience producing GEOINT or FMV-derived intelligence products.
Strong understanding of tactical intelligence analysis and operational intelligence workflows.
Experience working with multiple intelligence disciplines and mission systems.
Familiarity with geospatial intelligence concepts, methodologies, and analytic tradecraft.
Experience operating in a high-tempo, mission-focused environment.
Strong written, verbal, briefing, and analytical communication skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned analytical tasks while collaborating effectively with a broader intelligence team.

Core Competencies

GEOINT Analysis
Geospatial Analysis
Tactical Intelligence Analysis
Full-Motion Video (FMV) Analysis
A-ISR Operations
Motion Imagery Exploitation
Intelligence Production
Geospatial Visualization
Analytical Judgment
Mission Support
Written and Verbal Communication
Collaboration and Teamwork

Required: Active DoD TS/SCI security clearance.

At Nightwing, we value collaboration and teamwork. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside talented individuals who are passionate about what they do. Together, we’ll leverage our collective expertise to drive innovation, solve complex problems, and deliver exceptional results for our clients.

Thank you for considering joining us as we embark on this new journey and shape the future of cybersecurity and intelligence together as part of the Nightwing team.

jobs.title: GIS Developer – ALTO project / Cadence
jobs.description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The GIS Developer will support geospatial data integration, workflow automation, and land information management within a multidisciplinary infrastructure environment. Working closely with GIS, land, design, and digital delivery teams, the successful candidate will help improve interoperability, data quality, and operational efficiency across multiple digital platforms.

Missions/Main Duties

Design, develop, maintain, and optimize FME workflows to transform, validate, and integrate data across systems such as geographic information systems, computer-aided design/building information modelling platforms, document repositories, and external data sources.
Support the integration of land, survey, utility, environmental, and alignment data into GIS environments.
Develop data pipelines and connectors to enable reliable, scalable exchange of information between project systems and application programming interfaces.
Support the structured management of high-volume land parcel and property information for use in GIS and land acquisition processes.
Develop automated workflows to support the identification and tracking of requested properties and lands, as well as the management of land attributes such as access dates, occupancy, and temporary use requirements.
Populate, update, and maintain GIS datasets used for land request submissions and related project workflows.
Implement automation solutions to reduce manual effort in repetitive and high-volume tasks, including data ingestion, synchronization, validation, quality control, reporting, and submission preparation.
Ensure workflows are rule-based, scalable, and integrated with project systems and controlled data repositories.
Integrate FME workflows with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro, web GIS services, and the project’s common data environment to support secure storage, controlled access, and efficient data sharing.
Enable publication of data to web-based GIS platforms for stakeholder access, review, and interaction.
Apply data validation rules, schema controls, and metadata preparation practices aligned with geospatial standards and project requirements.
Support traceability and auditability of data transformations and exchanges across systems.
Prepare GIS datasets and workflows that support advanced digital delivery use cases, including digital twin integration and cross-discipline information flows between GIS, BIM, and other project management systems where required.
Deliver clean, structured, and reliable datasets to support analytics, simulation, reporting, and decision-making.
Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams across GIS, land, environment, design, and digital delivery functions.

Profile/Skills

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in geomatics, geography, geographic information systems, engineering, computer science, or another relevant field. An equivalent combination of education and practical experience may also be considered.

Years of experience:
A minimum of 10 years of experience in professional experience in geospatial data integration, enterprise GIS environments, workflow automation, and land or infrastructure-related data management is required. Experience supporting large infrastructure, transportation, or other complex multidisciplinary projects will be considered a strong asset.

Technical Competencies

Advanced proficiency with FME, including Form, Flow, and/or Server
Strong experience with ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Pro
Experience working with geodatabases, spatial data models, and structured geospatial datasets
Knowledge of extract, transform, and load processes, application programming interfaces, and data integration frameworks
Familiarity with data exchange between GIS and design environments such as CAD or BIM platforms
Experience with relational databases, data validation, and quality assurance / quality control processes
Strong understanding of land and parcel-based data models, multi-stage land acquisition workflows, and management of high-volume datasets
Experience working within common data environments and multi-stakeholder digital delivery ecosystems
Ability to design reusable, scalable, and maintainable ETL workflows
Understanding of interoperability, system integration, and good data governance practices
Ability to support structured data delivery for analytics, reporting, simulation, and digital twin applications
Clear verbal and written communication skills, both in French and in English*
Reasons for requiring bilingualism: You will have the opportunity to work with a varied clientele, including both French- and English-speaking companies. Bilingualism is therefore fundamental to building strong relationships with our customers, understanding their specific needs, communicating effectively in their preferred language and facilitating strategic meetings.

Personal & Soft Skills

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data quality
Ability to manage priorities in a dynamic project environment
Collaborative mindset and ability to work across disciplines, including GIS, BIM, land, environment, and design teams
Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to varied stakeholders
Proactive, organized, and solution-oriented approach to work

jobs.description:
Plan, organize and coordinate all aspects of environmental programs. Develops procedures and coordinates activities to solve pollution problems. Conducts research studies to develop theories or methods of abating or controlling sources of environmental pollutants by performing the following duties.

Essential Responsibilities:

Prepare environmental research project feasibility and progress reports.
Coordinate activities of research personnel conducting successive phases of problem analysis, solution proposals, and testing.
Review technical aspects of project to assist staff and assess productivity of lines of research.
Review project operations to ensure coordination of efforts and timely submission of reports.
Analyze reports to evaluate program effectiveness and budgetary needs.
Approve expenditures necessary for completion of project.
Coordinate planning, testing, and operating phases to complete project.
Confer with local regulatory agencies to discover local environmental quality standards, industrial practices, and new developments in pollution abatement.
Provide technical assistance to agencies conducting related environmental studies.
Determine data collection methods to be employed in research projects and surveys.
Plan and develop research models.
Identify and analyze sources of pollution to determine their effects.
Collect and synthesize data derived from pollution emission measurements, atmospheric monitoring, meteorological and mineralogical information, and soil or water samples.
Prepare graphs, charts, and statistical models from synthesized data.
Analyze data to assess pollution problems, establish standards, and develop approaches for control of pollution.
Knowledge of Federal and State environmental regulations.
Knowledge of Safety and Continuous Improvement Programs.

Perform all other position related duties as assigned or requested.

Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:

Bachelor's degree (B. S.) from four-year college or university with five (5) years related experience and/or training in Environmental Safety; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience with Emergency Planning and Community Right to Know Act (EPCRA), Tier II, and Toxic Release Inventory (TRI) preferred. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, customers, and the general public. Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Must have knowledge of Federal and State environmental regulations and of Safety and Continuous Improvement Programs. Position may require the ability to pass and maintain a Security Clearance.

$50K-$60K

Broadbent & Associates, Inc.
of Atlanta Metro Area, Georgia
is looking to hire an organized full-time Project II or Senior Project Geologist / Environmental Scientist
to oversee a wide variety of complex, environmental projects in Georgia, Alabama, South Carolina, and Florida. This position earns a competitive salary
(title and salary based on skills and experience), depending on experience. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package
, including 100% medical insurance monthly premium coverage, dental, vision, a health savings account (HSA), a generous 401(k) retirement plan with safe harbor contribution and company match, vacation, sick leave, life insurance, bonus opportunity, solid opportunities for advancement, and a friendly and fun work environment in all our offices
. If this sounds like the right environmental consulting opportunity for you, in the environmental remediation and water resources arena, consider applying today!

About Broadbent & Associates, Inc.

Founded in 1987, we are an environmental remediation, water resource, and civil engineering firm. We provide professional services throughout the United States to energy companies, mining operations, agricultural industry, municipalities, private industries, governmental agencies, public and private utilities, and developers. Our mission is to build long-term client relationships by providing sound scientific solutions to comprehensive resource management challenges. We're very client-focused with a commitment to providing services in a time-efficient and cost-effective manner.

We take care of our customers AND employees like family. Our ability to hire and retain long-term skilled key personnel has significantly contributed to our success. That's why we offer highly competitive pay
, opportunities for personal growth
, and a great work environment with a strong sense of camaraderie
.

A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A PROJECT II or SENIOR PROJECT GEOLOGIST / ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST

As a Project-level Professional, You Are The Driving Force Behind Our Business. Your Hard Work Ensures That We Deliver For Our Clients. Under The Supervision Of a Division Manager, You Will

Prepare and review of work plans, technical documents, and reports for federal, state, and local agencies
Prepare and review of new clientele proposals for federal, state, and private industry
Develop the scope of environmental assessment and remediation projects from our diverse portfolio and manage budgets
Conduct regular field visits to drive project execution and ensure that appropriate technical and health and safety procedures are being followed
Review and approve vendor work proposals and invoices
Write project reports, analyze, and interpret data, and prepare final reports to be submitted for Senior and clients review
Business development

Your people skills are essential as you interact regularly with clientele and regulatory agencies. Though you do spend a lot of time visiting job sites and interacting with people, you also complete various administrative responsibilities. Ensuring that clients are happy as well as that all jobs are delivered on time, within the scope, and on budget, gives you a great sense of accomplishment!

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in geology, hydrogeology, earth, or environmental science
Professional Geologist (PG) certification (preferred)
Five or more years of experience in geological assessments, water supply, water treatment, environmental assessments, contaminant investigation, contaminant remediation, storm water management, wastewater treatment, permitting projects, or compliance projects in the public and private sectors
Consulting experience
Strong working knowledge of federal and state environmental regulations and experience interacting with governmental regulatory agencies
Demonstrated ability to properly manage multiple projects concurrently while ensuring compliance with deliverable timelines
Ability to travel within the eastern regional US

Desired Qualities

Possess strong work ethic and knowledge of the consulting business
Strong commitment to Safety and staff development
Possess ability to effectively manage personnel and administrative functions
Advanced technical capabilities associated with the specific field of expertise
Motivated self-starter and ability to perform periodic field work
Strong problem solving, research, and communication skills
Ability to identify and mitigate potential hazards associated with site operations
Willingness to conduct Business Development activities
Technical writing competency and computer literacy
In-depth experience with service line specific cost projections, budget preparation and tracking
Ability to work individually and as a team member

Are you detail-oriented? Do you have strong problem-solving and research skills? Are you organized and able to effectively prioritize multiple projects and tasks? Do you have excellent communication skills? Are you energetic, self-sufficient, and motivated? Do you have a strong commitment to safety and staff development? Are you collaborative and team-oriented? If so, you might just be perfect for this position!

WORK SCHEDULE AND LOCATION

This full-time project management position typically works Monday - Friday with some traveling, overnight and weekend work. May engage extended two- or three-week projects regarding emergency response (voluntary).

READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?

We understand your time is valuable and that is why we have a very quick and easy application process. If you feel that you would be right for this project management job, please fill out our initial 3-minute, mobile-friendly application
. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:
Position Description

The GIS Specialist will be responsible for the development, implementation, and management of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to support the Risk Management and Emergency Management functions within Harris County. This role will involve analyzing spatial data, creating detailed maps, and ensuring that GIS systems are effective, accurate, and used to support critical decision-making processes during emergency events, risk management activities, and long-term planning.

Duties & Responsibilities:

GIS Development & Management:

Design, develop, and maintain GIS systems that support emergency management and risk mitigation initiatives.
Implement GIS data layers for medical facilities, nursing homes, fuel stations, critical infrastructure, and other areas relevant to risk management and emergency response.
Collaborate with department heads and stakeholders to identify GIS data needs for operational and strategic purposes.
Ensure GIS systems are integrated with other county systems to provide accurate, real-time information during emergencies and for routine risk assessments.

Data Analysis & Mapping:

Analyze spatial data related to hazards, risks, and infrastructure to create informative maps and reports.
Develop, update, and maintain accurate GIS databases, ensuring they reflect current conditions and strategic needs.
Perform geospatial analysis to assist in decision-making and resource allocation for emergency planning and risk management efforts.

System Support & Maintenance:

Regularly maintain and troubleshoot GIS systems to ensure optimal functionality.
Monitor and update GIS layers as needed to ensure data accuracy and timeliness.
Provide technical support for GIS users within the department, offering guidance on system tools, processes, and best practices.

Collaboration & Coordination:

Work closely with other county departments (e.g., Precinct Engineering, Public Safety, and Environmental Services) to ensure GIS systems align with countywide needs.
Coordinate with external agencies, such as local and state emergency management agencies, to ensure compatibility and shared resources.
Provide GIS training and guidance to department staff as needed.

Reporting & Documentation:

Prepare reports, maps, and visual data presentations for senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Maintain detailed documentation of GIS systems, processes, and updates for compliance and future reference.

Master’s degree in related field.

The GIS Developer will support geospatial data integration, workflow automation, and land information management within a multidisciplinary infrastructure environment. Working closely with GIS, land, design, and digital delivery teams, the successful candidate will help improve interoperability, data quality, and operational efficiency across multiple digital platforms.

Design, develop, maintain, and optimize FME workflows to transform, validate, and integrate data across systems such as geographic information systems, computer-aided design/building information modelling platforms, document repositories, and external data sources.
Support the integration of land, survey, utility, environmental, and alignment data into GIS environments.
Develop data pipelines and connectors to enable reliable, scalable exchange of information between project systems and application programming interfaces.
Support the structured management of high-volume land parcel and property information for use in GIS and land acquisition processes.
Develop automated workflows to support the identification and tracking of requested properties and lands, as well as the management of land attributes such as access dates, occupancy, and temporary use requirements.
Populate, update, and maintain GIS datasets used for land request submissions and related project workflows.
Implement automation solutions to reduce manual effort in repetitive and high-volume tasks, including data ingestion, synchronization, validation, quality control, reporting, and submission preparation.

Integrate FME workflows with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro, web GIS services, and the project’s common data environment to support secure storage, controlled access, and efficient data sharing.
Enable publication of data to web-based GIS platforms for stakeholder access, review, and interaction.
Apply data validation rules, schema controls, and metadata preparation practices aligned with geospatial standards and project requirements.
Support traceability and auditability of data transformations and exchanges across systems.
Prepare GIS datasets and workflows that support advanced digital delivery use cases, including digital twin integration and cross-discipline information flows between GIS, BIM, and other project management systems where required.
Deliver clean, structured, and reliable datasets to support analytics, simulation, reporting, and decision-making.
Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams across GIS, land, environment, design, and digital delivery functions.

Profile/Skills

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in geomatics, geography, geographic information systems, engineering, computer science, or another relevant field. An equivalent combination of education and practical experience may also be considered.

Years of experience:
A minimum of 10 years of experience in professional experience in geospatial data integration, enterprise GIS environments, workflow automation, and land or infrastructure-related data management is required. Experience supporting large infrastructure, transportation, or other complex multidisciplinary projects will be considered a strong asset.
